prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single isolated architectural 3D game prop reference for image-to-3D modeling, for Tetherbound's realm-travel portals.
Subject: one complete freestanding ancient stone gateway, a broad gently pointed arch made from substantial pale weathered grey-beige stone voussoirs, two solid slightly tapered stone piers on small individual plinths, a distinct keystone, restrained aged bronze inset bands on the inner jambs. Thoughtful handcrafted fantasy architecture, inviting with a hint of mystery, belonging to a cozy stylized creature expedition world. Broad readable shapes and clean bevels with restrained edge wear, matte stone and subtle moss in a few lower crevices, consistent stylized PBR game-art finish. Its silhouette should read as designed masonry rather than box primitives. Avoid tiny noisy ornament.
Proportions: overall roughly 4.5 metres wide, 5.2 metres tall and 0.9 metre deep, with a generous empty walk-through aperture about 3 metres wide and 3.8 metres high. The two feet end on the same plane. The entire opening is empty, visibly background through the opening; no door, no opaque portal disc, no glass, no veil, no glowing membrane. In-game cyan energy will be a separate effect. No obstruction or continuous threshold slab between the feet.
Composition: entire asset visible with generous margins, almost-front three-quarter view only 12 degrees from frontal so the opening remains fully legible and masonry depth is shown on one side, vertical camera with minimal perspective. Centered on a clean light neutral background and floor, soft even studio lighting and a light contact shadow. ONE object only. No scenery, characters, labels, text, symbols, UI, border, multi-view board, floating parts, flowers, weapons, red accents, or separate props. Not a photograph; polished real-time stylized architectural asset.
source: User explicitly requested a Meshy run for portals; inspected reference before submission.
